column6: Bullet 1 correction said free NH4+ is released mainly inside liver/kidney cells; overstated (gut releases free ammonia into portal blood). Narrowed to: the carriers give up their NH4+ mainly in liver/kidney.
Explainer said ALT turns alanine into pyruvate and ammonia; ALT makes pyruvate + glutamate, and glutamate dehydrogenase releases NH3 (new mis bullet 2 was right).
Core Idea said all three aromatic amino acids are exclusively glucogenic; Phe, Tyr and Trp are all both glucogenic and ketogenic (Explainer already said so for Tyr).
Enzyme name "dihydrobiopterin reductase" corrected to dihydropteridine reductase.
Worked numbers check: Q = 1e-4, RT ln Q = -23.8, total about -54 kJ/mol.
T/F keyed true said leucine is the ONLY purely ketogenic common amino acid; lysine is too. Reworded to "Leucine is a purely ketogenic amino acid".
Explainer said leucine is unique among common amino acids as purely ketogenic; now names leucine and lysine.
Noted, not fixed: Core Idea fasting range 80-100 mg/dL (70-100 is the usual reference).
Explainer said SREBP directly senses cholesterol; SCAP is the sensor (new mis bullet 2 was right). Reworded.
Noted, not fixed: Core Idea/Explainer call cholesterol a direct allosteric inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase; sterol-accelerated degradation of the enzyme is the better-supported mechanism.

T/F keyed true claimed cells CANNOT synthesize cholesterol in a low-energy state because NADPH is consumed; absolute and conflates NADPH with energy charge. Restated as AMPK inactivating HMG-CoA reductase so synthesis slows (matches the explanation).
Core Idea listed acetyl-CoA (a substrate) as a citrate synthase inhibitor; replaced with citrate, matching the Explainer.
Writer-flagged: old How said competitive inhibition gives "parallel lines"; lines meet on the y-axis (parallel = uncompetitive).
Core Idea said competitive inhibitors can be irreversible (covalent); contradicts Explainer and kinetics (covalent inactivation lowers Vmax). Reworded.
Error budget 1e-5 x 1e-2 = 1e-7, x 1e-3 near 1e-10 checks.
Bullet 4 correction (Pol I removes primer and fills gap) is bacteria-specific; eukaryotes use RNase H/FEN1 and Pol delta. Added "In bacteria".
Core Idea said Pol III removes primers; only Pol I does (5'->3' exonuclease).
All six EC assignments (LDH 1, hexokinase 2, G6Pase 3, aldolase 4, TPI 5, pyruvate carboxylase 6) verified.
Core Idea and Explainer said six EC classes; EC 7 translocases added in 2018. Added a clause/sentence; kept the six-class mnemonic as "classic" classes.

Writer-flagged: Core Idea said FAD takes two electrons and ONE proton (FADH2 = 2e- + 2H+, as Explainer says) and that FADH2 enters the ETC at Complex II in general (beta-oxidation FADH2 goes via ETF to ubiquinone). Both corrected.
Explainer said FADH2 enters at Complex II in general; now says at ubiquinone via Complex II or ETF. Noted, not fixed: Q3 explanation still frames all FADH2 as Complex II.
Noted, not fixed: Q0/Explainer say liver glycogen is exhausted by 12-18 h; depletion is usually closer to ~24 h.

T/F keyed false read "Most unsaturated fatty acids have lower melting points than saturated..." which is true (even trans elaidic 45 C < stearic 69 C). Restated so false is unambiguous; explanation clause "melting points similar to saturated" changed to "well above their cis isomers".
8 acetyl-CoA, 7 ATP, 14 NADPH verified.
Writer-flagged: Explainer said all four reactions per cycle consume NADPH; only the two reductions do (14 NADPH per palmitate).
Core Idea said synthesis is "allosterically ... inhibited by AMP, palmitoyl-CoA, and glucagon"; glucagon and AMP act via phosphorylation (PKA/AMPK), not allosterically. Reworded.
Anticodon pairings IGC->GCU/GCC/GCA and GAA->UUU/UUC verified antiparallel.
Glycine example claimed an inosine tRNA reads GGU/GGC/GGA; tRNA-Gly is not inosine-modified. Swapped to the alanine box (IGC), matching the Explainer.
4 ATP + 2 GTP + 2 NADH per glucose verified.
glucose-6-phosphatase, found only in liver and kidney -> "mainly" (small intestine also expresses it).
3 ATP vs 2 ATP to lactate verified.
Said a linear polymer presents "two ends" to phosphorylase; it has one non-reducing end (contradicted Q4 answer).

Absolute: said the activated species always reacts in the active site before diffusing; many mechanism-based inhibitors have partition ratios > 0 and release some reactive species. Added "usually". Old answer field has the same absolute ("immediately"); left.
Core Idea equated irreversible with "mechanism-based"; contradicts new mis bullet 1 (suicide inhibitors are a subset). Removed the parenthetical.
+2 -6 = -4 ATP verified.
Noted, not fixed: Q4 explanation says L/P ratio distinguishes Type A from Type B lactic acidosis but then says it is elevated in both.
Bullet 2 correction said perilipin must be phosphorylated before lipases can reach triglyceride at all; basal ATGL lipolysis runs without it. Qualified to full hormone-stimulated lipolysis.
Garbled sentence ("because glucagon activates phosphodiesterase would degrade cAMP") repaired.
Style only: typo "its primarily role" -> "its primary role".
